responsibility: Provides the main shared runtime support for C, Objective-C, and related front ends, including global type nodes, language option state, common tree utilities, and front-end helper logic used before GENERIC/GIMPLE lowering. It owns much of the common C-family semantic infrastructure such as built-in type initialization state, string and initializer helpers like braced_lists_to_strings, common flag variables, parser/preprocessor globals, and miscellaneous shared services that neighboring files specialize further for attributes, warnings, formatting, or lowering.
same_name_distinction: Main executable implementation for shared C-family support: it defines globals such as parse_in and many helper routines and common semantics, whereas c-common.h is the broad declaration surface for that subsystem and c-common.def is the declarative list of extra C-family tree codes consumed by GCC generation machinery.
